definition: A sudden cheerful readiness to act or respond.
author: Jane Austen
quote: After a couple of minutes’ unbroken silence, Henry, turning to Catherine for the first time since her mother’s entrance, asked her, with sudden alacrity…
example_sentence: He accepted the offer of cake with alacrity.
